items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Don Murray was a fine clarinet player... They also had an arrangement of the --that Don Murray had made... He was an excellent musician. Good arranger.

ctx.x: In Wilkes Barre, right on the square. So, we went down and I knew, as I said, I knew Farrar and some of the guys in the band. I went up and talked to them and they played the arrangement. Who was in the band? There was Trumbauer in the band, there was Bix in the band. They now had five brass. Three trumpets, two trombones. Three saxophones. Jimmy had gone to New York and they got Trumbauer in there and Don Murray was a fine clarinet player, he played tenor, so actually it worked out well. Anyway, the band sounded…
You mentioned Bix. Was this the first time you saw Bix and Trumbauer?
